prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent eight-pose game-character source sheet for review
Primary request: Create one cohesive rounded full-body pixel-art sheet for the ordinary clinic patient in everyday civilian clothes in Image2. Image1 controls only GS026 pixel-art style, proportional scale and eight-pose layout. Image2 controls every identity/outfit detail: a 54-year-old adult woman with medium brown skin, shoulder-length dark corkscrew curls with silver streaks, square teal glasses, and a full-figured build. They wear a dusty-rose full-sleeved cardigan over an ivory top, sage-green wide-leg trousers and plum flats. All sleeves are full length to the wrists. No badge, lanyard, scrubs or white coat. Preserve every detail across all eight views.
Composition/framing: exactly two rows and four isolated full-body figures. Top left-to-right: standing SOUTH/front, EAST/true profile facing screen-right, WEST/true profile facing screen-left, NORTH/rear. Bottom same order: seated SOUTH/EAST/WEST/NORTH. Broad transparent gutters and generous row gap; every head and shoe fully visible and well away from canvas edges. Seated figures sit on invisible chairs, knees bent around90degrees, hands naturally on thighs, feet flat; no chair visible. Same head/body scale and proportions in standing and seated views. Sleeves remain full-length to wrists; outfit layers and garment hems rest naturally while seated.
Style/medium: soft rounded high-quality pixel art matching Image1, compact friendly proportions, crisp dark pixel-stepped outlines and softly textured shading.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA background; no hat, equipment, held props, chair, furniture, floor, shadow, glow, scenery, logo, text, readable badge, watermark, labels, grid, duplicate/missing/cropped pose.
